value: Study population: 35 Swedish health care students (medical, nursing, dentistry)
Travel destinations: Indian peninsula (18 students) and Central Africa (17 students)
Specimens collected median 4 days before departure and 22 days after return
Two-thirds (23/35) participated in hospital-based patient work
No antibiotic intake within 6 months prior to fecal sampling
Sequencing technology: Illumina HiSeq 2000 for metagenomic analysis; Illumina MiSeq for ESBL isolates
178 different resistance gene types detected across all specimens
23 resistance genes found in all 70 libraries; 35 genes in ≥90% of libraries
9 of 178 genes exhibited significant change in abundance after travel
Overall fold change increase across all antibiotic categories: 1.06
